g.text: Mean earnings in urban Sindh rise with age and peak at 55-59 (Rs 542,400)
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: urban Sindh, ages 15-64, annual earnings > 0 (n = 2,644).
Red markers: weighted mean earnings of each five-year age band (hhweight), at the band midpoint.
Hollow markers = thin bands (< 30 earners; none here). Grey points: individual earners, jittered by up to 0.4 years.
The 2 earners outside Rs 10,000-10,000,000 lie off the log scale and are not drawn.
